declaredBreaks.reason: Documents (beta, documents feature flag) switch to schema version 2: the REST API, content-as-code files, CLI uploads, promotion and MCP Document tools now read and write { markdown, charts } instead of ordered cells, chart queries move from /cells/{cellIndex}/query to /charts/{chartId}/query, and version 1 payloads are rejected. API clients and CLI users with Document files must switch to the new shape.
